mapper.sql: p.id, p.title, p.price, p.status, p.version, p.create_time, p.update_time, ps.id AS sku_id, ps.sku_name AS sku_name, ps.sku_spec AS sku_spec, ps.status AS sku_status, ss.available_stock AS available_stock, ss.locked_stock AS locked_stock, COALESCE(net.net_sold, 0) AS sold_stock

LEFT JOIN t_product_sku ps ON ps.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN t_sku_stock ss ON ss.sku_id = ps.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, GREATEST(0, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_type = 'ORDER_COMMIT' THEN -locked_delta WHEN operation_type IN ('REFUND_RESTORE', 'REFUND_RESTOCK', 'RETURN_RESTOCK') THEN -available_delta ELSE 0 END)) AS net_sold FROM t_inventory_operation GROUP BY product_id ) net ON net.product_id = p.id
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, price, status, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_product WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM t_product p
WHERE p.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM t_product p
WHERE p.id IN
#{id}
ORDER BY p.id

SELECT FROM t_product p
ORDER BY p.id

SELECT FROM t_product p
WHERE p.status = 'ON_SHELF' AND ps.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ss.sku_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.id
